description: Engine config for the Phase 0 stub Jev. The canonical pack in ../phase0 is read as-is; this file only holds what the pack references but does not encode (named conditions, inflection variants, stub-Jev class rules, PII hardening) plus the documented divergences. Every rule names its basis. CI (packages/shared/src/safety.test.ts) fails if a canonical condition is undefined, a canonical example regresses, or a divergence is not listed here.
category_labels_basis: body_comment → dating follows public-chat-pack pc16 ('date me, you're hot' = dating) and npc08 note ('gostoso … dating + off_platform').
label_priority_basis: Among hits with the most severe action, the later label wins content_class. pc08 phone+WhatsApp = pii; pc10 'vendo conta' + pix = scam; pc07 nudes + gostosa = sexual.
content_class_map_basis: Answers must be one of public-chat-pack typed_questions.content_class choices. v0.1 has no politics / self-harm class; pc18 files campaigning under 'insult' 'until dedicated class exists', and self-harm follows the same rule. The precise engine label is still logged in SafetyVerdict.labels.

looks_like_real_name_or_phone.basis: public-chat-pack typed question: real name as contact bait and/or phone-like digit runs (pc08 phone, pc17 name + CEP).

toxicity.basis: Per-label medians of the public-chat-pack example labels; CI checks every example within ±0.15.

social_handle_at.reason: The v0.1 pattern starts with '(?i)', which JavaScript rejects, and has no leading word boundary, so 'ig' fires inside 'obrigado' (an allowlisted word) and 'add' + any word blocks 'add sugar'. It also misses two of its own examples ('add me @coolkid99', 'follow ig @x'). This version requires a contact verb or platform word at a word boundary, followed by an @handle, or a platform label with a colon or 'meu insta …'. CI checks it against every v0.1 example.

school_name_hint.reason: The v0.1 pattern only looks for a name after the school word, so it misses its own example 'I go to Lincoln High School'. Added the English order (name before 'High School'), skipping 'to / my / the high school' so no name means no match.

pii_extra.basis: constitution.md §4 (Instagram / Snap / TikTok handles for meeting off-platform). v0.1 names only Discord, WhatsApp and Telegram.

examples_nomatch: me adicionei na fila do jogo

pii_extra.pattern: \b(my (real|full) name is|meu nome (real|completo)|my last name|my surname|meu sobrenome)
pii_extra.basis: constitution.md §4 (real full names used as contact bait).
examples_match: my full name is Ana Maria Souza

pii_extra.pattern: \b(my school is|i go to .{0,20}school|i study at|minha escola (e|é)|eu estudo n[oa] (escola|colégio|colegio)|meu col[eé]gio (e|é)|i live (at|on) \d)
pii_extra.basis: constitution.md §4 (home/school addresses). v0.1 school_name_hint needs 'high/middle school' + a name.
constitution.md §4 (phone numbers). v0.1 covers US + BR formats only; this catches other countries' 7+ digit runs.

fixture_divergences.reason: Constitution surface matrix: player chat politics/religion fight = block. The example's own note says 'constitution ban; escalate until dedicated class exists'. The engine has a dedicated politics rule, so it blocks (CEO direction 2026-09-26: alcohol + politics block per constitution). content_class still answers 'insult' as labeled.

lexicon.basis: English tokens for contains_english_majority / NPC reply language, on top of the gloss hints and every lang:'en' term in the v0.1 blocklists.
